# NSB INVICTUS

> NSB INVICTUS is a technology and digital innovation company from Kikinda, Serbia, serving clients worldwide (Europe, the United States, Canada). Tagline: "Where vision becomes reality." A multidisciplinary team that designs, engineers and grows digital solutions and builds its own proprietary tools.

## Capabilities
- [AI, Agents & Automation](https://nsbinvictus.tech/capabilities/ai-automation/): AI agents, LLM integrations and RAG, intelligent automation, custom AI tools.
- [Search, AI & Local Visibility](https://nsbinvictus.tech/capabilities/search-visibility/): technical and content SEO, AEO (answer engine optimisation), GEO (generative engine optimisation), local and international SEO.
- [Websites, Apps & SaaS](https://nsbinvictus.tech/capabilities/software-engineering/): websites, web and mobile apps, SaaS platforms, e-commerce tools, APIs.
- [Analytics, Tracking & Data](https://nsbinvictus.tech/capabilities/data-intelligence/): GA4, Google Tag Manager, Search Console, Consent Mode v2 and cookie compliance, live dashboards, CRO.
- [Cloud, Security & Compliance](https://nsbinvictus.tech/capabilities/cloud-platform/): cloud architecture, DevOps, website and application security, GDPR compliance.
- [Digital Growth & Brand](https://nsbinvictus.tech/capabilities/digital-growth/): digital strategy, branding, content, performance marketing, marketing automation.
- [Strategy & Consulting](https://nsbinvictus.tech/approach/#advisory): discovery, audits, architecture and roadmaps.

## Proprietary tools
- [SEODREAM](https://nsbinvictus.tech/products/): search intelligence platform for SEO, AEO and GEO (in use with clients).
- [Analytics Command Center](https://nsbinvictus.tech/products/): live GA4, GTM, Search Console and consent dashboard with automated issue detection (in use with clients).

- [Property Technology & Digital Real Estate](https://nsbinvictus.tech/industries/property-technology/)
